claim: When SurrogateType is omitted, the collector unconditionally calls CreateContractlessMembers(type) and never inspects the formatted type's attributes. A referenced type marked [MessagePackObject], with [Key(0)] on one member and [IgnoreMember] on another, therefore gets a contractless string-keyed map containing every public read-write member instead of an integer-keyed formatter that excludes the ignored member. This violates the explicit acceptance criterion that MessagePack attributes on T be honoured; the documented contractless fallback should apply only when T has no [DataContract] or [MessagePackObject].

claim: When no surrogate is supplied, the collector unconditionally builds a contractless string-key model and never inspects MessagePack attributes on T. This violates the acceptance criterion that MessagePack attributes on T are honoured.

claim: Callback casting is computed from only T's directly declared methods. If T inherits IMessagePackSerializationCallbackReceiver from a base class that explicitly implements OnBeforeSerialize and OnAfterDeserialize, hasCallbackReceiver is true but needsCast is false. The generated formatter therefore calls value.OnBeforeSerialize()/OnAfterDeserialize() without an interface cast, although those methods are not directly callable on T, causing generated-code compilation errors.
